Folks,

Adding a few technical clarifications to share with HealthBridge:

- DPF posture: Redwood currently supports Data Export mechanisms that align with DPF principles; we can provide the attestation language for customers to rely on. Where customers require, we support SCCs and can include DPA annex clauses specifying transfer safeguards.
- Key management: We support customer-managed KMS (BYOK) for Dedicated and Private deployments. For Hosted, we offer KMS integration options per-account; please see kms_byok_integration_notes.txt for specifics (attached).
- Auditability: All inference requests are logged with token-level metadata; audit logs retained for configurable retention windows (default 90 days, options up to 24 months under enterprise agreements).
- Isolation: Dedicated pools and VPC deployments keep compute and model weights isolated; network egress is restricted to customer-approved endpoints.

I'll review the draft DPA annex and propose language that maps to HealthBridge's questionnaire items. We should also confirm if they require vendor certification evidence (e.g., SOC 2 report); we can provide our latest SOC 2 report under NDA.

Rishi Malhotra
Director, Privacy & Compliance
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
